title: Getting Started with Python
text: Python is a versatile programming language that is easy to learn. This tutorial covers the basics of Python including variables, loops, and functions. Perfect for beginners.

title: Advanced Python Design Patterns
text: This guide explores advanced Python design patterns such as singleton, observer, and factory patterns. Learn how to write more maintainable and scalable Python code.

title: JavaScript Web Development
text: JavaScript is the language of the web. This tutorial teaches you how to build interactive websites using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Learn DOM manipulation and asynchronous programming.

title: Data Science with Python
text: Python is widely used in data science. This course covers pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn for data analysis, machine learning, and visualization. Build real-world data science projects.

title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
text: Understand the fundamentals of machine learning including supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning. Learn algorithms and how to evaluate model performance.

title: Natural Language Processing with Python
text: NLP is a field of artificial intelligence that focuses on text analysis. Learn how to process text data using Python libraries like NLTK and spaCy for sentiment analysis and named entity recognition.

title: Deep Learning and Neural Networks
text: Deep learning uses artificial neural networks to process large amounts of data. This guide covers convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks, and transformers using TensorFlow and PyTorch.

title: Cloud Computing with AWS
text: Amazon Web Services offers a range of cloud computing services. Learn how to deploy applications, manage databases, and scale infrastructure using AWS EC2, S3, and RDS.

title: Docker and Containerization
text: Docker simplifies application deployment by containerizing software. Learn how to create, manage, and deploy Docker containers for consistent environments across development and production.

title: Kubernetes Orchestration
text: Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration platform. Master deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications using Kubernetes clusters and services.
